boss_schedule.name: Hogger
boss_schedule.announcement: Grrr... fresh meat!

boss_schedule.name: Mother Fang
boss_schedule.announcement: Mother Fang skitters out of the mine!

boss_schedule.name: Rhahk'Zor
boss_schedule.announcement: VanCleef pay big for your heads!

boss_schedule.name: Mr. Smite
boss_schedule.announcement: We're under attack! Avast, ye swabs! Repel the invaders!

boss_schedule.name: Edwin VanCleef
boss_schedule.announcement: Lapdogs, all of you!

boss_schedule.name: Naraxis
boss_schedule.announcement: Naraxis drops from the branches!

boss_schedule.name: Mor'Ladim
boss_schedule.announcement: You will join my army in death!

boss_schedule.name: Stitches
boss_schedule.announcement: Stitches hungry! Stitches eat!

boss_schedule.name: Lupos
boss_schedule.announcement: Lupos howls, and the Nightbane answer!

boss_schedule.name: Morbent Fel
boss_schedule.announcement: The dead of Raven Hill rise at my command!

boss_schedule.name: Doomguard Commander
boss_schedule.announcement: Your world is ours to burn!

boss_schedule.name: Mannoroth's Herald
boss_schedule.announcement: Kneel before the Legion!

boss_schedule.name: Varimathras
boss_schedule.announcement: The dreadlords remember Warsong. Do you?

boss_schedule.name: Lord Hel'nurath
boss_schedule.announcement: Who dares summon Hel'nurath? Your soul is forfeit!

boss_schedule.name: Lord Kazzak
boss_schedule.announcement: All mortals will perish!

boss_schedule.name: Ravasaur Matriarch
boss_schedule.announcement: The Ravasaur Matriarch shrieks, and her pack answers!

boss_schedule.name: Uhk'loc
boss_schedule.announcement: Uhk'loc beats his chest and charges!

boss_schedule.name: Lar'korwi
boss_schedule.announcement: Lar'korwi comes for whoever took her eggs!

boss_schedule.name: Tyrant Devilsaur
boss_schedule.announcement: The ground shakes as a Tyrant Devilsaur bursts from the trees!

boss_schedule.name: King Mosh
boss_schedule.announcement: King Mosh roars, and the whole crater falls silent.

boss_schedule.name: Kovork
boss_schedule.announcement: Kovork crush little ones! Basin belong to Boulderfist!

boss_schedule.name: Nimar the Slayer
boss_schedule.announcement: Your head will hang in Witherbark Village!

boss_schedule.name: Marez Cowl
boss_schedule.announcement: The Syndicate thanks you for your sacrifice.

boss_schedule.name: Lord Falconcrest
boss_schedule.announcement: The Basin was always Alterac's. We are only taking it back.

boss_schedule.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
boss_schedule.announcement: Alterac will rise again, and the Highlands will kneel to it!

boss_schedule.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
boss_schedule.announcement: Your blood will feed the forest's corruption!

boss_schedule.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
boss_schedule.announcement: The wilds will consume you!

boss_schedule.name: Tendris Warpwood
boss_schedule.announcement: Who disturbs the Warpwood?

boss_schedule.name: Immol'thar
boss_schedule.announcement: Immol'thar breaks free of its prison!

boss_schedule.name: King Gordok
boss_schedule.announcement: Me smash! You die!

boss_schedule.name: High Priestess Jeklik
boss_schedule.announcement: Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!

boss_schedule.name: High Priest Venoxis
boss_schedule.announcement: Let the coils of hate unfurl!

boss_schedule.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
boss_schedule.announcement: I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!

boss_schedule.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
boss_schedule.announcement: Welcome to da great show, friends. Step right up to die!

boss_schedule.name: Hakkar the Soulflayer
boss_schedule.announcement: PRIDE HERALDS THE END OF YOUR WORLD. COME, MORTALS! FACE THE WRATH OF THE SOULFLAYER!

boss_schedule.name: Houndmaster Loksey
boss_schedule.announcement: Release the hounds!

boss_schedule.name: Arcanist Doan
boss_schedule.announcement: You will not defile these mysteries!

boss_schedule.name: Herod
boss_schedule.announcement: Ah, I've been waiting for a real challenge!

boss_schedule.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
boss_schedule.announcement: Infidels! They must be purified!

boss_schedule.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
boss_schedule.announcement: Mograine has fallen? You shall pay for this treachery!

boss_schedule.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
boss_schedule.announcement: Korrak smash puny ones!

boss_schedule.name: Ivus the Forest Lord
boss_schedule.announcement: Who disturbs the slumber of the forest?

boss_schedule.name: Lokholar the Ice Lord
boss_schedule.announcement: I am the Ice Lord. Your blood will freeze in your veins!

boss_schedule.name: Glacius the Frozen Titan
boss_schedule.announcement: The mountain remembers. The mountain will bury you!

boss_schedule.name: Azuregos
boss_schedule.announcement: This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate!

boss_schedule.name: General Angerforge
boss_schedule.announcement: Dark Iron! To arms! Crush the intruders!

boss_schedule.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
boss_schedule.announcement: Blackrock will never fall! For the true Horde!

boss_schedule.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
boss_schedule.announcement: Come to aid the Throne!

boss_schedule.name: Majordomo Executus
boss_schedule.announcement: Reckless mortals! None may challenge the sons of the living flame!

boss_schedule.name: Nefarian
boss_schedule.announcement: Well done, my minions. The mortals' courage begins to wane! Now let's see how they contend with the true Lord of Blackrock Spire!

boss_schedule.name: Kurinnaxx
boss_schedule.announcement: The sands erupt as Kurinnaxx surfaces!

boss_schedule.name: General Rajaxx
boss_schedule.announcement: Impudent fool! I will kill you myself!

boss_schedule.name: Princess Huhuran
boss_schedule.announcement: Princess Huhuran goes into a frenzy!

boss_schedule.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
boss_schedule.announcement: Sands of the desert, rise and block out the sun!

boss_schedule.name: C'Thun
boss_schedule.announcement: YOU ARE ALREADY DEAD.

boss_schedule.name: Anub'Rekhan
boss_schedule.announcement: Ahh... welcome to my parlor.

boss_schedule.name: Noth the Plaguebringer
boss_schedule.announcement: Glory to the master!

boss_schedule.name: Patchwerk
boss_schedule.announcement: Patchwerk want to play!

boss_schedule.name: Sapphiron
boss_schedule.announcement: Sapphiron rises from the frozen lair, its wings filling the hall with frost!

boss_schedule.name: Kel'Thuzad
boss_schedule.announcement: Your petty magics are no challenge to the might of the Scourge!
